## Chemed Corporation to Present at the Jefferies 2026 Healthcare Services Conference


September 8, 2026 at 9:00 AM EDT


[PDF Version](https://www.chemed.com/node/23026/pdf)


CINCINNATI, Sept. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Chemed Corporation (NYSE:[CHE](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=NZ7k0sOYZP_TMj1ZkDE22lYqRGm9EYDloRr8x0_1GJTnY0xAFUWkF8_HlFXII27YHPAf58Uy1iAJjUNcIIJcxA==) ) today announced that it will deliver a presentation at the Jefferies 2026 Healthcare Services and Technology Conference on Tuesday, September 15, 2026, at approximately 10:55 a.m. (CT) at the 1 Hotel in Nashville.


The presentation will be webcast live and can be accessed, along with the presentation materials, through the Chemed website at[www.chemed.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=VL0bWyGnJ_YSW0fQ8lCJDXzIU_bEHLomlsHPKToIG6YWnhA5H6KDCR8LW1_ItTKuswDs1PLb_53S3_pkjM298w==) (Investor Relations). The webcast replay will be available within 24 hours of the live presentation and will be accessible for 90 days.


Listed on the New York Stock Exchange and headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, Chemed Corporation ([www.chemed.com](http://www.chemed.com/) ) operates two wholly owned subsidiaries:[VITAS](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=9nukqtOu2Hnd8HMokThvmIyNJlwIQBkGxxE791zH4hxYsTJ8UuunuoO8Ha5dWXD-BQX57zdtlFUMNVL-EqnITA==) Healthcare and[Roto-Rooter](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=3RoV_1Dp0qudE_z8MKzQH0_8ye9sa5AVgmcNDYq84oLSMMfDqdf6kOSVN13c_PzIPM26-jw2qAvwstcBHeLjVA==) . VITAS is the nation's largest provider of end-of-life hospice care and Roto-Rooter is the nation’s leading provider of plumbing and drain cleaning services.
